display.purpose: One dominant value or phrase on a top-level screen.

numeric.purpose: Time, money, weights, counts, and reports with tabular figures.

shadows.name: drag-lift
shadows.purpose: Temporary feedback while an object is reordered.

narrative.overview: Luqa combines Trade Republic-like decisiveness with the intimacy of a private life record. Every screen has one unmistakable focal point, while supporting information becomes deliberately quieter. Scale, contrast, alignment, and open space create boldness; decoration does not.
keyCharacteristics: Stark neutral contrast with rare, meaningful purple.
Personal data color on an otherwise quiet shell.
Crisp corners and flat continuous working surfaces.
Responsive motion and haptics without page choreography.

rules.name: The One Focal Point Rule
rules.body: Every screen chooses a single dominant object. If three elements compete, none is bold.

rules.name: The Shell and Life Rule
rules.body: The shell belongs to Luqa; the colors belong to Luca's life.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: If a surface is not modal, floating, or being dragged, it earns hierarchy through tone, border, space, or typography—not shadow.

dos: Do give each screen one dominant focal object and make the remainder support it.
Do use black/white inversion for ordinary primary actions so purple stays distinctive.
Do use identity colors for the owner's data and always pair color with a label, icon, shape, or position.
Do design and golden-test dark and light themes independently.
donts: Don't make Luqa resemble a corporate SaaS dashboard.
Don't use purple gradients, glowing borders, animated grids, or terminal typography as decoration.
Don't use constant confetti, mascot rewards, streak shame, or inflated celebration.
Don't build a collection of excessively rounded cards and pills.
Don't copy Trade Republic's financial metaphors or impersonal tone.
